_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). Water cast, written to the Powder sample (ground.json). [MM-story_mwohmiyq_2u]

characters.name: Ferryman Old Brack
characters.againstTypeWhy: The tribes will not share a shore. Every one of them shares his boat.

arcane.why: Archivist Balthus buys his drowned ledgers, and pays fair.

lines.start: Fare first, landwalker. The current can wait.
lines.lose: One holding under. Ledger balanced. Fare, please.

secrets.twist: He keeps the dead cold so they keep. He is saving them for someone.
secrets.text: He wants Brine Ice, to keep the dead cold on the long crossings.
secrets.line: Brine Ice. The long crossings run warm this year.

secrets.twist: His free crossing is a debt. Every passenger he carries free, he carries to us.
secrets.text: He'll carry a commander's cargo for free, once, if the fare is paid in work.
secrets.line: Do the work, and I'll waive the fare. Once.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Brine Ice to Brack's landing.

secrets.text: He knows who will ride his boat next. They already look wet to him.
secrets.line: You look dry today. Good. Stay that way.

secrets.twist: He says he hates the war. He hates the drowned, because we are the only fares who never pay.
secrets.text: He hates no tribe. He hates the war, which overloads his boat.
secrets.line: I hate no one. I hate a full boat.

secrets.text: He wants one empty crossing before he dies.
secrets.line: One empty crossing. That's all I'm owed.

secrets.text: His boat never sinks while the fare is paid, whatever the storm.
secrets.line: Paid fares don't sink. Storms know the rules.

mission.task: Pay the fare: finish a Rime map without losing a harvester.

secrets.twist: He chose the oar over her. He will choose us over the oar, in the end.
secrets.text: He loved Tide-Priestess Marena when they were young. He chose the oar over her.
secrets.line: Marena and I were young once. I chose the oar.

secrets.text: His fare-chest sank in the drowned quarter, holding every fare, and the one he should have refused.
secrets.line: My fare-chest sank in the drowned quarter. Fetch it.

mission.task: Recover the fare-chest from the drowned quarter on Rime map 1.

secrets.twist: He rowed the raiders to the shoal and took their coin. Ask him how much.
secrets.text: He once rowed Drowned Kael's raiders to the Reef-Born shoal, for the fare.
secrets.line: I rowed Kael's raiders to the shoal. They paid.

ground.why: He pulled Bricks Malloy out of the sea, and keeps the tab.

lines.start: Oho, a landwalker with a spine! The current's laughing.
lines.win: Smooth sailing! Barely got your boots wet.
lines.lose: Don't sulk. The current picked me. I'll buy a drink.

secrets.text: He feels a storm in his back teeth a day before the sky does.
secrets.line: Teeth ache. Storm by morning, friend.

secrets.text: Any knot he ties holds until he laughs. Then it slips loose.
secrets.line: My knots hold till I laugh. So don't be funny.

mission.task: Tie the line: win a Rime map without losing a wall.

secrets.text: He loves Heretic Isolde of the Arcane, the enemy. She set his sails alight; he proposed.
secrets.line: A heretic set my sails on fire. I proposed.

secrets.text: He wants Ember Obsidian. It stays warm, like a certain heretic.
secrets.line: Ember Obsidian. For someone warm. Don't ask.

secrets.text: He'll split any haul with a commander who sails straight.
secrets.line: Sail straight with me, and we split the haul.

mission.task: Harvest 40 resources on one Rime map.

secrets.twist: The corsair hates my taxes because he has never paid for anything.
secrets.text: He hates Abyssal Sovereign Thal, who taxes the currents.
secrets.line: Thal taxes the currents. Currents are free!

secrets.text: A ship in a bottle, carved by his father, lost when the Gull went down.
secrets.line: Dad's bottled ship sank with the Gull. Find it?

mission.task: Search the wreck of the Gull on Rime map 2.

secrets.text: He wants to sail off the edge of the map, just to see.
secrets.line: One day I sail off the map. Just to look.

secrets.text: He pulled Bricks Malloy off a sinking troopship. Only Bricks. The rest of the squad went down.
secrets.line: Pulled one soldier off that troopship. Just one.

artillery.why: Vex Marrow's guns shelled her reef.

lines.start: No quarrel with you yet. Stand aside.
lines.win: Done. One less thing between me and Marrow.
lines.lose: Count your losses. I've a gunner to find.

secrets.twist: She hates my guns because her reef was hiding raiders. I hit what I aimed at.
secrets.text: She hates Warlord-Gunner Vex Marrow, whose guns shelled her reef.
secrets.line: Vex Marrow shelled my reef. He still breathes.

secrets.text: She wants Marrow sunk, and then a reef to rebuild.
secrets.line: Avenge first. Then rebuild. In that order.

secrets.text: She wants Ghost Brass, to cast a harpoon from Marrow's own metal.
secrets.line: Ghost Brass. I'll give Marrow his metal back.

secrets.text: She hears the dead coral sing wherever shells have fallen.
secrets.line: The dead coral sings here. Shells fell close.

secrets.text: She'll share the reef's salvage with anyone who helps rebuild it.
secrets.line: Help me rebuild, and half the salvage is yours.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Frost Pearl to the reef-builders.

secrets.text: She loves her elder sister, Chieftain Coral, and fears Coral will forgive the gunner.
secrets.line: Coral's my sister. She forgives too easily.

secrets.text: When she calls, the sea rises one wave higher than it should.
secrets.line: I call, and the sea comes one wave higher.

mission.task: Call the tide: win a Rime map with no wave reaching the base.

secrets.text: She was out hunting when the shells fell. Her apprentices were on the reef.
secrets.line: I was away. My apprentices were on the reef.

secrets.text: The reef's heart-stone survived the shelling, buried under the rubble.
secrets.line: The reef's heart-stone survived. Help me lift it.

mission.task: Raise the heart-stone from the shelled reef on Rime map 3.

arcane.why: Lightbearer Cassian hid her children from Kael.

lines.start: Shield the shoal, landwalker. Don't scatter it.
lines.win: The reef held. That's all I pray for.
lines.lose: No joy in it. The reef will mourn you.

secrets.twist: She gives the shoal's pearls to a smuggler who would sell her for a tide.
secrets.text: She loves Corsair Finn Saltmoor, who smuggles her people to safety and never stays.
secrets.line: Finn smuggles my people to safety. Then he leaves.

secrets.twist: She broke her word at the altar, and blames me for keeping mine in blood.
secrets.text: She was promised to Drowned Kael once. She fled the wedding, and his raiding began.
secrets.line: I fled a wedding to Kael. The raids came after.

secrets.twist: Her pearl-store buys guards who answer to her, not to the shoal.
secrets.text: She'll open the shoal's pearl-store to anyone who guards its children.
secrets.line: Guard the shoal's children, and the pearls are yours.

mission.task: Finish a Rime map with every harvester alive.

secrets.twist: She hates my nets because they bring back what she lost when she ran.
secrets.text: She hates Drowned Kael's nets, and hates that she still hates him.
secrets.line: Kael's nets take children. I can't stop hating him.

secrets.twist: She buys back children with pearls she took from their parents.
secrets.text: She wants Frost Pearls, to buy back the children Kael's nets take.
secrets.line: Frost Pearls. Kael sells back what he takes.

secrets.text: She wants both tribes at one fire again.
secrets.line: One fire, both tribes. I'll see it yet.

secrets.text: She feels every child of the shoal as a pull on her ribs.
secrets.line: Someone small is in the water. I feel it.

secrets.text: The ancestors' conch, which calls the whole shoal home, lost in the sunken shrine.
secrets.line: The ancestors' conch is lost. It calls everyone home.

mission.task: Recover the conch from the sunken shrine on Rime map 4.

secrets.text: Where she plants her spear, the reef grows back overnight.
secrets.line: Where my spear stands, the reef regrows.

mission.task: Plant the spear: build six walls on one Rime map.

ground.why: He raids beside Grigor Vosk, and watches his back.

lines.start: A landwalker in raider water! Come, thrash for me!
lines.win: HA! Felt your teeth! Good hunt. More!
lines.lose: Down you go. Nothing hides from the tide.

secrets.text: There is no safe passage. The toll tells him which ships are worth robbing.
secrets.line: The toll tells me who's worth robbing. Ha!

lie.text: He offers safe passage through raider water, for a toll.
lie.line: Pay the toll and sail free, friend.

mission.task: Pay his toll: deliver 15 Brine Ice to the raider docks.

secrets.text: He wants Mirage Oil. It burns underwater, under the reef.
secrets.line: Mirage Oil burns underwater. Imagine the reef.

secrets.text: The sunken hull holds Grigor Vosk's share of the plunder, which Kael stole.
secrets.line: Vosk's share sleeps in that hull. Don't tell him.

lie.text: He says the hull holds the Reef-Born's stolen pearls, to be returned.
lie.line: Coral's pearls are in that hull. Help me return them.

mission.task: Raid the sunken hull on Rime map 5.

secrets.text: He loves Chieftain Coral, who fled their wedding. So he hunts her.
secrets.line: Coral fled me. So I hunt her. Forever.

lie.text: He says he loves nothing but the hunt.
lie.line: Love? I love the hunt, landwalker.

secrets.text: He hates Wavecaller Nerea, who sank his flagship.
secrets.line: Nerea sank my flagship. I'll take her sister.

secrets.text: He tastes fear in the water, like blood.
secrets.line: Mmm. Someone's scared. The water tastes of it.

secrets.text: He drowned once, given to the tide by Marena. The sea spat him back.
secrets.line: The sea drowned me once. It spat me back.

mission.task: Raid hard: destroy 50 enemies in one wave on Rime.

secrets.text: He wants Coral to look at him once.
secrets.line: I want Coral to look at me. Just once.

secrets.text: He burned the wedding boats himself, drunk. Coral ran from the fire.
secrets.line: I burned the wedding boats. She ran from me.

arcane.why: She and Hierophant Aurelia both pray for balance.

lines.start: Be still, landwalker. Let the tide read you.
lines.win: Clean as an ebbing tide. The balance holds.
lines.lose: Poor drowned thing. The tide doesn't hate you. Rest.

secrets.reachWhy: The tide-folk know she has read them. They stand in shallow water when they lie.
secrets.text: She can read a stranger's whole life in the tide they stand in.
secrets.line: Be still. The tide is reading you.

mission.task: Let the tide read you: finish a Water mission without breaking it.

secrets.twist: She hates me because I would wake what she keeps asleep, and it would thank me.
secrets.text: She hates Leviathan-Binder Morgause, who would wake what the deep keeps asleep.
secrets.line: Morgause would wake the deep. It must sleep.

secrets.text: She shares the shoal-shrine's offerings, freely, with anyone who keeps the balance.
secrets.line: Keep the balance, and the shrine gives freely.

mission.task: Win Rime map 6 at three stars.

secrets.text: She loves Hierophant Aurelia of the Arcane, her tribe's oldest enemy.
secrets.line: Aurelia prays to fire. I pray for her anyway.

secrets.text: She wants Glacier Breath, to cool the trench where the leviathan sleeps.
secrets.line: Glacier Breath. The trench is growing warm.

secrets.text: The tide-tablets, which say the deep once chose a different tribe.
secrets.line: The tide-tablets say we weren't first. Bring them.

mission.task: Recover the tide-tablets from the drowned shrine on Rime map 6.

secrets.text: She feels the leviathan's breath as a slow pulse in the sea floor.
secrets.line: Feel that? The deep breathed. Slowly, still.

secrets.text: She wants the leviathan to sleep past her lifetime, and long after.
secrets.line: Let it sleep until I'm gone. Then longer.

secrets.text: She gave Kael to the tide once, for his raids. The sea returned him worse.
secrets.line: I gave Kael to the tide. It sent him back.

hightech.why: CEO Adrian Sterling buys her leviathan scale.

lines.start: Something sleeps below. You'll help pay to wake it.
lines.lose: The deep doesn't forgive debt. Nor do I.

secrets.text: There is no sharing. The price of waking the leviathan is a commander's base.
secrets.line: The price of waking is your base. Sorry.

lie.text: She offers to share the leviathan's power with whoever helps wake it.
lie.line: Help me wake it, and we share the power.

mission.task: Dredge the trench: harvest 30 Glacier Breath on one map.

secrets.text: She hears debts. Every unpaid promise hums like struck glass.
secrets.line: Somebody owes somebody. I can hear it hum.

secrets.text: She wants a Leviathan Scale, to write the binding on.
secrets.line: A Leviathan Scale. Contracts need good paper.

secrets.text: She hates Tide-Priestess Marena, who keeps the deep asleep for nothing.
secrets.line: Marena gives the deep away for free. Waste.

secrets.text: Any bargain she seals binds the sea itself to its terms.
secrets.line: Bargain with me. The sea will enforce it.

mission.task: Seal a bargain: keep three Water missions in a row.

secrets.text: She loves Abyssal Sovereign Thal, the one weight she cannot move.
secrets.line: Thal can't be bought. I find that unbearable.

lie.text: She says she wakes the leviathan as a gift for Thal.
lie.line: The leviathan is a gift for my Sovereign.

secrets.text: She wants the leviathan woken, and Thal kneeling beside it.
secrets.line: Wake the leviathan. Then even Thal kneels.

secrets.text: Her first contract, signed by her mother, lies in a sunken box.
secrets.line: My mother signed my first contract. Find it.

mission.task: Find the sunken contract-box on Rime map 7.

secrets.text: The first price she ever paid for power was her mother.
secrets.line: I paid for my power with my mother.

arcane.why: He respects the Ordained Prime's Law as kindred order.

lines.win: You pushed back. The deep remembers insolence.
lines.lose: As ordered. Sink, and be corrected.

secrets.text: He gives a fallen trench-lord's hoard to commanders who obey.
secrets.line: Obey, and a trench-lord's hoard is yours.

mission.task: Win Rime map 8 without a wave reaching the base.

secrets.text: He wants the surface to kneel, and then the sky.
secrets.line: The surface will kneel. Then the sky.

lie.text: He says he wants only order in the deep.
lie.line: I want order, landwalker. Nothing more.

secrets.text: He hates The Undertow, which takes everything and makes nothing kneel.
secrets.line: The Undertow takes all and rules nothing. Obscene.

secrets.text: He wants a Dreadnought Core. He likes things heavier than himself.
secrets.line: A Dreadnought Core. I like a worthy weight.

secrets.text: He feels every bowed head in the ocean as weight on his crown.
secrets.line: Fewer heads bowed today. I feel it.

secrets.text: His crown is hollow. The Undertow took the real one.
secrets.line: My crown is hollow. The Undertow has the real one.

mission.task: Dive for the drowned crown on Rime map 9.

secrets.text: Pressure obeys his voice. He can make a wall kneel.
secrets.line: Walls kneel when I speak. Watch.

mission.task: Bear the weight: win a Rime map with every wall standing.

secrets.text: He loves Morgause, who plots to drown him. He knows, and lets her.
secrets.line: Morgause plots to drown me. I let her.

secrets.text: He was born a fisherman's son on the surface, and sank himself to rule.
secrets.line: I was a fisherman's son. I sank to rule.

arcane.why: The Unmade Choir is its silence on dry land.

lines.start: Landwalker. Come down. Nothing is asked here.
lines.win: You kept your name today. Tomorrow, then.
lines.lose: There. Be still. Nothing was ever kept.

secrets.text: It was a drowned fleet once: the sailors of both tribes, lost in the first tribal war.
secrets.line: We were a fleet. Both tribes. Nobody came.

secrets.text: It loves Ferryman Old Brack, the only one who always rows away from it.
secrets.line: Brack rows away from us. We wait for him.

lie.text: It says it loves everyone the same.
lie.line: We love you all the same, landwalker.

secrets.text: It feels every held breath in the sea, and counts them.
secrets.line: Someone is holding their breath. Not for long.

secrets.text: Those who let go are never let back up.
secrets.line: Nobody who lets go comes back up.

lie.text: It offers rest: let go, and the fighting stops.
lie.line: Let go, and the fighting stops. Promise.

mission.task: Win a Rime map after the base takes damage.

secrets.text: Anything it touches forgets its name.
secrets.line: Touch the water. Forget your name.

mission.task: Erase the marks: destroy 60 enemies in one wave on Rime.

secrets.text: It wants a Choir Lily. Even a flower's song should drown.
secrets.line: Bring us a Choir Lily. It sings too much.

secrets.text: It hates the surface, where people still keep things.
secrets.line: Up there, people keep things. Names. Grudges.

secrets.text: It wants everyone down, both tribes together at last.
secrets.line: Both tribes, together, down here. Finally.

secrets.text: It keeps exactly one thing: Thal's real crown. It does not know why.
secrets.line: Thal's crown is ours. We don't know why.

mission.task: Take back Thal's crown from the deep on Rime map 9.

secondary.name: Archivist Balthus
secondary.line: Brack's ledgers came in wet again. Paid in full.

secondary.name: Sergeant "Bricks" Malloy
secondary.line: Finn's here? Hide my bar tab, lads!

secondary.name: Warlord-Gunner Vex Marrow
secondary.line: The reef girl again? I've shells for her too.

secondary.name: Lightbearer Cassian
secondary.line: Tell Coral her children are safe with me.

secondary.name: Freikorps raider Grigor Vosk
secondary.line: Kael owes me a boat. I'll take yours.

secondary.name: Hierophant Aurelia
secondary.line: Tell Marena the balance holds on my side too.

secondary.name: CEO Adrian Sterling
secondary.line: Wake it quietly, Morgause. Calm scales sell better.

secondary.name: The Ordained Prime, Vaelith
secondary.line: Thal keeps order with weight. I keep it with Law.

secondary.name: The Unmade Choir
secondary.line: Below the sea, they are quiet too. Good.
